```{css, echo=FALSE}
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, sans-serif;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 20px;
}

.container {
    background: white;
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 60px 40px;
    max-width: 600px;
    width: 100%;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}

h1 {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    color: #2d3748;
}

.subtitle {
    color: #718096;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    margin-bottom: 40px;
}

.cv-options {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 20px;
}

.cv-card {
    border: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 30px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    display: block;
}

.cv-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-color: #667eea;
}

.cv-card h2 {
    color: #2d3748;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.cv-card p {
    color: #718096;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.icon {
    font-size: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .container {
        padding: 40px 25px;
    }
    
    h1 {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }
}
```
